description: This is a shell script that contains test cases for git reset behavior, specifically examining reset commands in bare and non-bare repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; executes the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
